subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Produzir resenhas, a partir das notas e/ou esquemas feitos, com o manejo adequado das vozes envolvidas (do resenhador, do autor da obra e, se for o caso, também dos autores citados na obra resenhada), por meio do uso de paráfrases, marcas do discurso reportado e citações.

components.description_pt: Gerenciar múltiplas vozes — resenhista, autor resenhado e autores citados — apropriadamente em resenha
components.description_en: Manage multiple voices — reviewer, reviewed author, and cited authors — appropriately in a written review
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how cited textual evidence strengthens a written argument or reflection

components.description_pt: Usar paráfrase e marcadores de discurso reportado para atribuir ideias a fontes em resenha
components.description_en: Use paraphrase and markers of reported speech to attribute ideas to their sources in a review
components.cc_component_description: Follow a standard citation format when referencing sources in writing

components.description_pt: Incorporar citação direta corretamente para sustentar afirmações avaliativas em resenha
components.description_en: Incorporate direct quotation correctly to support evaluative claims in a written review
components.cc_component_description: Distinguish between paraphrasing and direct quotation when restating information from diverse formats

components.description_pt: Produzir resenha baseando-se em notas ou esboços previamente feitos
components.description_en: Produce a review drawing on previously made notes or outlines
components.cc_component_description: Take brief notes on sources while researching a topic

cc_matches.description: Draw evidence from literary or informational texts to support analysis, reflection, and research.

Gather relevant information from multiple print and digital sources, using search terms effectively; assess the credibility and accuracy of each source; and quote or paraphrase the data and conclusions of others while avoiding plagiarism and following a standard format for citation.
Paraphrase portions of a text read aloud or information presented in diverse media and formats, including visually, quantitatively, and orally.
Recall information from experiences or gather information from print and digital sources; take brief notes on sources and sort evidence into provided categories.
